display.purpose: Brand wordmark on standalone pages (login, register, player splashes).

h2.purpose: Section headings, panel titles, sidebar wordmark, dialog titles.

stat.purpose: Hero numeric on the dashboard network readout. Tabular numerics baked in.

label.purpose: UI labels, nav rows, buttons, tile titles, body text. The workhorse.

eyebrow.purpose: Section eyebrows, panel category labels, tab labels.

mono.purpose: All reported data: counts, sizes, durations, timestamps, IDs, pairing codes. Geist Mono with tabular numerics.

shadows.name: status-glow
shadows.purpose: The only always-on glow, on a mint online dot, so live reads at a glance.

shadows.name: primary-cta-halo
shadows.purpose: Inset top-edge highlight plus a warm gold drop behind the single primary button. Earned, not decorative.

shadows.name: menu-cast
shadows.purpose: Account menus, dropdowns, login card, modal dialogs. The only cast shadow for floating layers.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for fades and reveals. Exponential, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-shell
motion.purpose: Sidebar collapse width transition (the one layout-prop exception).

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile → desktop shell switchover. Below md: top bar (wordmark + account) plus bottom tab bar. At/above md: a single top bar with inline nav tabs, no side rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary CTA on a screen. Gold background, deep-indigo text, earned halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.81 0.155 75); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 290); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.002em; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25) inset, 0 8px 20px -10px oklch(0.81 0.155 75 / 0.6); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.74 0.165 70); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral non-primary action. Surface-2 with a thin border. No halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.24 0.034 290); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.14); border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.20 0.028 290); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirm. Saturated coral with on-danger deep-warm text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.74 0.135 25); color: oklch(0.20 0.04 25); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.74 0.135 25 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Surface-2 input with strong border, gold focus ring, accessible error linkage.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); } .ds-input { background: oklch(0.24 0.034 290); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.14); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.35; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The flat replacement for the old floating Card. Surface-1 with a hairline border, no drop shadow at rest.
components.html:
Pair new screen

Enter the six-character code shown on the TV to claim it.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: oklch(0.20 0.028 290); border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.07); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.35; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.66); }

components.name: Screen Tile
components.description: A cell on the screen-wall grid. Status dot + name, mono relative time, current playlist. Online derives from lastSeen freshness.
components.html:
Lobbynow
Promos Q2
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; background: oklch(0.20 0.028 290); padding: 1.25rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tile:hover { background: oklch(0.24 0.034 290); } .ds-tile-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-tile-id { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-dot--on { background: oklch(0.78 0.12 165); color: oklch(0.78 0.12 165); box-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor; } .ds-dot--off { border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); } .ds-tile-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tile-time { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tile-list { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.66); } .ds-tile-list svg { color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Mobile Tab Bar
components.description: Primary mobile navigation, replacing the side drawer. Bottom-fixed, four columns, active icon in a violet pill.
components.html: DashboardMediaPlaylistsScreens
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); background: oklch(0.22 0.032 290 / 0.92); border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.14); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; min-height: 3.5rem; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; width: 3.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.66); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab-pill { background: oklch(0.62 0.21 280 / 0.16); color: oklch(0.62 0.21 280); } .ds-tab-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); } .ds-tab-label--active { color: oklch(0.62 0.21 280); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Badge (Info)

narrative.overview:
Yugo's admin is a live operations console for one technical operator running five Smart TVs. The interface is a dark indigo control surface stitched together by a hairline grid, with instrument-grade data in mono and a single gold filament for the next action. It reads like a piece of broadcast hardware, not a SaaS dashboard: the operator opens it, sees the state of the wall at a glance, makes the change, and leaves.

Surfaces are flat. Depth comes from tonal layering (surface-1 over the body) and 1px seams between cells, not from floating cards with drop shadows. Status is structural: a mint dot for online, a coral row for offline, a violet tab for the current page. Color always carries meaning. Gold is punctuation reserved for the primary path. Calm is earned through hierarchy and dark space, never through hiding information the operator needs.

This system explicitly rejects, as named in PRODUCT.md: generic SaaS gradient dashboards (2022 to 2025), the hero-metric template, identical-card grids, glassmorphism by default, Linear/Vercel visual cosplay, consumer-warm cream tones (Notion-light, Stripe-marketing), crypto and AI terminal aesthetics (neon-on-black, brutalist grids, scanlines), and corporate BI tools (circular brand-color icons, gratuitous charts).
keyCharacteristics: Dark indigo foundation (hue ~290°) with a faint off-axis violet body wash. No photo washes behind UI.
Four semantic accents: gold (action), mint (online/success), violet (info, current nav), coral (danger), with amber for caution.
Flat surfaces joined by hairline seams. Collections are a single bordered grid of cells, not a scatter of floating cards.
Geist Sans carries all UI text. Geist Mono carries all instrument data: counts, sizes, timestamps, IDs, pairing codes.
Mobile is a first-class surface. A bottom tab bar (not a side drawer) puts navigation under the thumb.

rules.name: The Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Yugo Gold is punctuation, never decoration. One gold cluster per screen: the next action, the focused field, or the brand moment. If gold appears on more than ~10% of a screen, the hierarchy has collapsed.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Pixel Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff. Every neutral carries a tiny brand chroma. The closest to black is oklch(0.15 0.022 290); the closest to white is oklch(0.985 0.004 80).

rules.name: The Meaning-Bearing-Color Rule
rules.body: Color names a state: online (mint), current nav (violet), action (gold), danger (coral), caution (amber). If a colored element doesn't carry one of these meanings, it's the wrong color.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A single Geist family covers the whole UI. A fancy heading is weight plus scale, never a new family.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Every reported value uses Geist Mono with tabular numerics: counts, file sizes, durations, relative timestamps, screen IDs, pairing codes. Mono is what makes the console read as an instrument. Prose and labels stay in sans; data is mono.

rules.name: The Token-Or-Don't Rule
rules.body: Use the scale utilities (text-display, text-h1, text-h2, text-stat, text-label, text-eyebrow, text-meta) plus font-mono. Stacking text-sm font-medium tracking-tight inline is forbidden; it is how scales drift.

rules.name: The Hairline-Seam Rule
rules.body: A collection is one bordered container (rounded-xl border border-border) wrapping a grid whose cells are separated by 1px gaps over the border color (grid gap-px bg-border, cells bg-surface-1). The result is a single instrument panel of cells, not a scatter of independent cards.

rules.name: The Flat-Collection Rule
rules.body: Lists and grids of objects (screens, playlists, media) never use per-item drop shadows. Items are flat cells that respond to hover with a tonal lift to surface-2. Shadows are a response to floating, not a default.

rules.name: The Earned-Halo Rule
rules.body: The gold halo behind primary buttons is reserved for the single primary action on a screen. Two halos on the same screen mean one of them isn't actually primary.

dos: Do lead with the type-scale utility classes (text-h1, text-stat, text-label, text-eyebrow, text-meta). They bake size, leading, tracking, and weight together.
Do put every reported value in font-mono with tabular numerics: counts, sizes, durations, timestamps, IDs, codes.
Do build collections as a single hairline-seam grid (one bordered container, gap-px bg-border cells), not a scatter of floating cards.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; reach for a lighter surface and a hairline border before any shadow.
Do carry status with shape, icon, or label alongside color (mint dot vs hollow ring, not color alone).
Do use semantic color tokens (bg-accent, text-info, bg-danger-soft), never the raw --yugo-* brand colors.
Do keep gold rare: one primary action per screen, one focused field at a time.
Do size touch targets ≥44px on mobile; the on-site flow is thumb-driven.
Do use the bottom tab bar for mobile navigation, and details or inline reveals over modals.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion; fade transitions only, 150 to 250ms, exponential ease-out, no bounce.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard tropes: purple-to-blue gradients, glass cards by default, the hero-metric template, gradient text, identical-card grids, or modal-first flows.
Don't give collection items per-item drop shadows or wrap each in a floating card. Flat cells, hairline seams.
Don't put a photo or image wash behind the UI; it reads dated. Depth comes from tonal layering, not background imagery.
Don't use a full-height side drawer for mobile navigation; it covers the screen. Use the bottom tab bar.
Don't clone Linear or Vercel surfaces directly. Borrow the reliable-and-technical register, not the visual signature.
Don't introduce consumer-warm cream tones: Notion-light, Stripe-marketing cream, beige. Yugo lives in dark.
Don't drift into crypto / AI terminal aesthetics: neon-on-black, monospace everywhere, brutalist grids, scanlines. Mono is for data, not the whole UI.
Don't ape corporate BI tools: circular brand-color icons, gratuitous charts, density without earning it.
Don't use #000 or #fff. Every neutral carries the brand chroma.
Don't put a border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on a cell, list item, or callout.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient. Use a single solid color for emphasis.
Don't put gold on more than one element-cluster per screen. Two golds means one isn't actually primary.
Don't use em dashes or double-hyphens in UI copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't stack ad-hoc type utilities (text-sm font-medium tracking-tight). Use a scale class.
Don't call native window.confirm or alert. Use the in-app ConfirmDialog.
